purpose: Arrange a control with its label, explanation and errors.
avoid: A visible label alone does not establish a programmatic association.
basis: Native source page 1188:4205 (Field), observed anatomy and examples.
openDecisions: Control binding, required/invalid states, description/error IDs and grouping.
profileRationale: Meaningful content or content container; not classified as decorative. Any interactive descendants need separate behavior and accessibility contracts.
